title: YouTube AdFree
shortDescription: Development build that experimentally neutralizes the captured standalone ad-playback state response.
description: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 7 keeps the revision 6 diagnostics and adds a deliberately narrow active experiment based on two real-TV captures: when AdBlock is enabled and a parsed response consists exactly of responseContext, trackingParams, and isAdPlayback=true, GTV preserves the response envelope but changes only isAdPlayback to false before YouTube consumes it. The diagnostics observer runs first, so the original true event remains visible in the on-TV report. Normal player responses, nested isAdPlayback fields, false states, and objects with any extra top-level fields are left untouched.

added: Experimental standalone ad-playback state neutralizer for the exact responseContext + trackingParams + isAdPlayback=true shape captured twice on real hardware.
Regression coverage proving the neutralizer ignores normal player responses, nested fields, false states, incomplete envelopes, and objects with additional top-level state.
changed: DEV diagnostics remain installed ahead of the neutralizer, so captured isAdPlayback=true events are recorded before the response is changed to false.
DEV version advanced to 7690.5.3 / GTV revision 7 for over-the-air testing.
fixed: Targeted the previously unhandled compact ad-playback state transition instead of broadening Home renderer deletion heuristics.
